dialogue.content: こんにちは相談者役をさせていただきます１０時ちょうどスタートでお願いできますか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'll be playing the role of the client. Could we please start exactly at 10 o'clock?

dialogue.content: (本日はよろしくお願いいたします。時間になりましたら始めさせていただきます。）
dialogue.English: (I look forward to working with you today. We will begin when it's time.)

dialogue.content: （はい、こちらこそ、よろしくお願いします）
dialogue.English: (Yes, likewise. Thank you.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。本日はお越しくださりありがとうございます。はじめにご年齢、性別、相談内容を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in today. To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to talk about?

dialogue.content: こんにちはよろしくお願いします４４才　女性子供会役員での活動で不快な思いをしてるんです
dialogue.English: Hello, thank you. I'm 44 and female. I've been having unpleasant experiences in my role as a children's association officer.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。具体的にはどのようなことが起こっているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Could you tell me more specifically what has been happening?

dialogue.content: はいいろいろあるんですが、特に最近、嫌だったことは、
dialogue.English: Yes, well, there are a number of things, but something that particularly bothered me recently...

dialogue.content: 浜谷さんという人とソフトボールの担当なんですが、
dialogue.English: I'm in charge of softball with someone named Ms. Hamaya,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: ある男子が試合に出るかどうかで、
dialogue.English: Regarding whether a certain boy would play in a game,

dialogue.content: 話がくいちがって
dialogue.English: we were not on the same page,

dialogue.content: 浜谷さんから、電話で、まるで子供に怒鳴るように、
dialogue.English: Ms. Hamaya called me on the phone and yelled at me, just like you would yell at a child,

dialogue.content: せめてきたんです
dialogue.English: and really laid into me.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。それはびっくりするし嫌な気持ちになりますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must have been startling and upsetting.

dialogue.content: あなたと浜谷さんとの話の食い違いはなにがあったのですか？
dialogue.English: What was the misunderstanding between you and Ms. Hamaya about?

dialogue.content: そうなんですよ元々、浜谷さんが、携帯家に忘れたから、頼まれて、私がその男子のママに代わりに電話したんです。試合に出たい意思があるかどうかを。
dialogue.English: Yes, exactly. It started because Ms. Hamaya had forgotten her phone at home, so she asked me to call the boy's mother on her behalf to ask if he wanted to play in the game.

dialogue.content: それで、
dialogue.English: And then,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 電話してた所がかなりの騒音で、
dialogue.English: it was very noisy where I was calling from,

dialogue.content: 聞こえづらかったんですが、
dialogue.English: so it was hard to hear, but

dialogue.content: なんとか聞いて、習い事の関係で、あまり試合に出れないから、
dialogue.English: I managed to hear that because of his other lessons, he wouldn't be able to make it to many games,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: ユニホームもいらない、限りがあるので、無しということで、
dialogue.English: and since there's a limited number of uniforms, he wouldn't need one. He would pass.

dialogue.content: 浜谷さんに伝えたんです
dialogue.English: That's what I told Ms. Hamaya.

dialogue.content: なるほど。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そしたら、２日後に電話で怒鳴ってきたんです
dialogue.English: And then, two days later, she called and yelled at me.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。浜谷さんはなんとおっしゃったのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. What did Ms. Hamaya say?

dialogue.content: その男子、試合に出たいらしいけど、なんでそんなこと言ったの？と…
dialogue.English: She said something like, 'Apparently that boy wants to play in the game, so why did you say that?'

dialogue.content: ええ、そうだったのですね。いきなり怒鳴られたらびっくりしますよね。そのときあなたはどう感じたのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. It must be shocking to be yelled at out of the blue like that. How did you feel at that moment?

dialogue.content: 私は、男子のママに、最後にどちらかはっきりと聞いたのに…だから、男子のママに電話したんです
dialogue.English: But I had clearly asked the boy's mom for a final answer... So, I called her again.

dialogue.content: ええ、そしたらどうでしたか？
dialogue.English: Yes, and what did she say?

dialogue.content: そのママもびっくりして、今から浜谷さんに電話してみるって言われました
dialogue.English: The mother was surprised too and said she would call Ms. Hamaya right away.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。その男子のママさんも息子が試合に出るつもりだったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. So, did the boy's mother intend for her son to play in the game?

dialogue.content: いえ、少しは出たい気持ちもあるようなんですが、習い事でかなり練習を休まなくてはいけないので、限りがあるユニホームを受け取るには、気がひけてたらしく…その後、男子のママから、「浜谷さんに電話して事情説明したので大丈夫です」って言われました
dialogue.English: No, it seems he did want to play a little, but since he would have to miss a lot of practice for his other lessons, he felt bad about taking one of the limited uniforms... Afterwards, the boy's mom told me, 'I called Ms. Hamaya and explained the situation, so it's fine now.'

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。あなたとその男子ママとは話が合っていたけれど、浜谷さんとは食い違ってしまっていたのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you and the boy’s mother were on the same page, but there was a mismatch with Ms. Hamaya.

dialogue.content: それでいきなり怒鳴られたら納得いきませんよね
dialogue.English: Being suddenly yelled at like that must feel unfair.

dialogue.content: そうなんですよ私の説明不足も原因のひとつだと思いますが、まるで子供にしかるような口調で「この人大丈夫？」ってひいちゃいました
dialogue.English: Exactly. I think my explanation may have been insufficient, but the way she spoke, like she was scolding a child, made me recoil and think, 'Is this person okay?'

dialogue.content: その数日後、
dialogue.English: A few days after that,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 打ち合わせで、
dialogue.English: at a meeting,

dialogue.content: 会ったら
dialogue.English: when I saw her,

dialogue.content: 何事もなかったように、
dialogue.English: as if nothing had happened,

dialogue.content: 今までにないくらい、
dialogue.English: more than ever before,

dialogue.content: めっちゃ笑顔気持ち悪いくらいの笑顔で挨拶してくるんです
dialogue.English: she greeted me with this huge, almost creepily big smile.

dialogue.content: なるほど。それはなんだか少し怖いですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That does feel a bit unsettling, even scary.

dialogue.content: あなたはどう反応されたのですか？
dialogue.English: How did you react to that?

dialogue.content: 普通に今まで通り、
dialogue.English: I just acted normally, the same as always,

dialogue.content: 接しましたが、
dialogue.English: and interacted with her, but

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 他のママ友から、浜谷さんの問題行動をいくつか聴いて納得しました
dialogue.English: I heard about several of Ms. Hamaya's problematic behaviors from other mom friends, and it all made sense.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。あなたはどう納得されたのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. In what way did that make sense to you?

dialogue.content: すぐに怒ったり、人に嫌われる言動があるタイプだから、
dialogue.English: Because she's the type of person who gets angry easily and tends to say or do things that alienate people,

dialogue.content: ええ、なるほど。
dialogue.English: Mm, I see.

dialogue.content: その時も誤解してすぐに感情のコントロールができなかったんだと。
dialogue.English: I realized that at that time, she must have misunderstood and just couldn't control her emotions.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。あなたはそう感じて納得されたのですね。しかしながら、消化はできましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. So that's how you came to understand it. However, have you been able to move past it?

dialogue.content: あと半年もいっしょに活動しないといけないと思うと、消化は完全にはできないので、嫌です
dialogue.English: When I think that I have to work with her for another six months, I can't completely move past it. I really don't like it.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。ご自身では相手の性格や周りのお話などで行動の原因は理解してはいるものの、一緒に活動していくのも嫌になりますよね
dialogue.English: I understand. Even though you understand the reasons for her behavior, based on her personality and what you've heard from others, it's still unpleasant to have to continue working with her.

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんですよまたいつ怒ってくるかと思うと…
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s right. I worry about when she might get angry again...

dialogue.content: そうですよね。怒鳴られるかもしれないと思うと不安にもなりますもんね
dialogue.English: Right. The thought that you might be yelled at must make you anxious.

dialogue.content: はい、異常な口調で…うちの子と同級生なんですが、お子さんもかわいそうだなって思います
dialogue.English: Yes, in that abnormal tone... Her child is in the same grade as mine, and I feel sorry for her child too.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。お子さんに対してもあなたに対する態度と同じようなことをされているのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Does she treat her child in a similar way to how she treated you?

dialogue.content: 他のママ友の話だと、自販機のジュースおねだりしたら、バシッって怒鳴って殴ったとか…
dialogue.English: According to other mom friends, when her child begged for a juice from a vending machine, she suddenly yelled and hit them...

dialogue.content: あらら、それは周りのひともびっくりしますよね。
dialogue.English: Oh my, that must have been shocking for everyone around her.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。あとは、別のママ友を無視したりとか…他人を不快にさせるタイプみたいです
dialogue.English: Exactly. And she also ignores another mother... She seems to be the type of person who makes others uncomfortable.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。そういう方とあなたは今まで一緒に頑張ってこられたのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. And you've been working hard alongside someone like that all this time.

dialogue.content: よく耐えてこられたのですね。
dialogue.English: You've really put up with a lot.

dialogue.content: 人数的にしょ～がないので…
dialogue.English: Given the number of people, it can’t be helped...

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。お二人で活動されているのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Are just the two of you working on this?

dialogue.content: うちの子は男子なので、子供男子四人、女子も四人で…活動が別で、女子の方のママは楽しそうです
dialogue.English: My child is a boy, and there are four boys and four girls in total... the activities are separate, and the mothers in the girls' group seem to be having fun.

dialogue.content: 私と浜谷さんは、ソフトボール担当なんです
dialogue.English: Ms. Hamaya and I are in charge of the softball group.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。女子チームの楽しそうな姿を見ると辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It must be difficult to see the girls' group having so much fun.

dialogue.content: そうなんですよ他の人が子供会役員活動が楽しかったという話を聴くと、複雑です
dialogue.English: That’s right. When I hear others say their children’s association officer activities were enjoyable, I have mixed feelings.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。そう感じるのも自然なことだと思います。あと半年一緒に活動されるとのことですが、何か気になることや心配なことなどありますか？
dialogue.English: I understand. I think it's natural to feel that way. You mentioned you'll be working together for another six months. Is there anything in particular you're worried or concerned about?

dialogue.content: ソフトボールは夏で終わるのでいいのですが、
dialogue.English: The softball season ends in the summer, which is good, but...

dialogue.content: 男子ママ３人と仲良く慣れなくて、
dialogue.English: I just can't seem to get along with the other three mothers in the boys' group,

dialogue.content: 居心地がすごく悪いです。
dialogue.English: so it's very uncomfortable for me.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。それはお辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: そうなんです波長が合わないので最悪です
dialogue.English: Yes, it is. We're just not on the same wavelength, so it's awful.

dialogue.content: そのようにお感じなのですね。あと半年それが続くとなると嫌な気持ちになってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: I understand that's how you feel. It must be upsetting to think this will continue for another six months.

dialogue.content: そうなんですでも「あと半年だけだし」と、何年も続くわけではないので、なんとかなるかなって感じです
dialogue.English: Yes, it is. But I also feel like, 'It's only for another six months.' It's not like it will go on for years, so I think I can probably manage.

dialogue.content: でも嫌…
dialogue.English: But I still don’t like it...

dialogue.content: そうですよね。割り切って関わっていこうと思っても居心地の悪さを考えると苦しいですよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. Even if you try to just put up with it, the thought of that discomfort is still painful.

dialogue.content: そうなんですよお金を稼げる仕事でもなく、ボランティアのようなものですし…
dialogue.English: Exactly. And it's not a job where I'm earning money; it's more like volunteer work...

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなると余計活動する意味を見出せなくなったりもしますものね
dialogue.English: Yes, and that can make it even harder to find any meaning in these activities.

dialogue.content: そうなんですしかも息子は、ソフトボールやりたくないと言うので、参加してませんしね
dialogue.English: Exactly. On top of that, my son says he doesn't want to play softball, so he's not even participating.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。ご自身の子供さんがいないなか頑張ってこられたのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you've been working so hard even though your own son isn't involved.

dialogue.content: はい役員１年やるのは、地域の決まりなので。
dialogue.English: Yes, it's a community rule that you have to be an officer for one year.

dialogue.content: なるほど。息子さんがいないなか、周りの子供さんのために活動されてきたのですね。
dialogue.English: I understand. You’ve been working for the sake of the other children even though your son isn’t involved.

dialogue.content: 決まりなので、やるしかありませんから…でも他のお子さんと接して楽しかったところもあります。
dialogue.English: It's a rule, so I have to do it... But there have been enjoyable moments, too, from interacting with the other kids.

dialogue.content: 母親には嫌われ、子供には好かれるタイプみたいです
dialogue.English: I seem to be the type who is disliked by the mothers but liked by the children.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。お辛い状況もありながらも楽しく活動できた部分もおありだったのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So even with all the difficult circumstances, there were also parts of the activities that you were able to enjoy.

dialogue.content: そうですね今日お話してみて、そう感じました！それと、愚痴れてかなりスッキリしました！
dialogue.English: Yes, talking with you today has made me realize that! Also, just being able to vent has made me feel much better!

dialogue.content: お話を聞いていると子供たちと真摯に向き合っておられると感じました。
dialogue.English: As I've been listening to you, I get the sense that you engage with the children very sincerely.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます!
dialogue.English: Thank you!

dialogue.content: お辛い状況かとは思いますが、「こどもたちの笑顔のために」頑張ってみるのもいいかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: I know it's a difficult situation, but perhaps trying to do your best 'for the sake of the children's smiles' might be a good approach.

dialogue.content: そうですね！
dialogue.English: Yes, you're right!

dialogue.content: お話の途中で申し訳ありませんが、本日はそろそろ終了のお時間が近づいてきてしまいました。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry to interrupt, but our time for today is almost up.

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Okay, thank you.

dialogue.content: 本日はありがとうございました。これにて終了させていただきます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in today. This concludes our session.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Thank you very much!

dialogue.content: （お疲れ様でした）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time.)

dialogue.content: （ロールプレイありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for the role-play.)

dialogue.content: （終了お願いします）
dialogue.English: (Please end the session.)
